prompt: The disk is 512 bytes. Which of these requests must `disk_write(offset, src, len)` accept? Select all that apply.
explain: A request is valid when every byte lies in [0, 512), with an empty request at the very end (offset 512) allowed. 510 + 6 runs past the end, 513 starts past it, and the wrapping case only looks small because of overflow: its true end is far beyond 512. Checking `offset > 512 || len > 512 - offset` gets every case right.
